description: Replace names, IBANs, account ids, UETRs and references in a pacs/camt message with consistent pseudonyms. With `path` + `output_path`, writes the scrubbed copy to disk and returns only masked statistics, so the original data never enters the conversation. Never overwrites an existing file.

output_path.description: Where to write the scrubbed XML. Must not exist yet and must differ from `path`.

path.description: Path to a local XML file. Prefer this for real data so it never enters the chat.

name: scrub_payment_message
title: Scrub payment message
